items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: It is time to say goodbye to NASA's Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory. After nearly 22 years of service, the satellite re-entered Earth's atmosphere on November 4 at 7:39 EST over the North Sumatra region of Indonesia. The featured image is a mosaic created in 2018 using the first one million images captured by the satellite's Ultraviolet/Optical Telescope. items.title: אשדוד
items.summary: אַשְׁדּוֹד היא העיר הגדולה במחוז הדרום, והשמינית באוכלוסייתה בערי מדינת ישראל. נוסדה ב-1956 והוכרזה כעיר ב-1968. העיר שוכנת לחופו של הים התיכון במישור החוף הדרומי, מדרום ליבנה, מצפון לאשקלון וממערב לגן יבנה, בקצה הדרומי של מטרופולין גוש דן. בשטחה זורם נחל לכיש.

items.label: From the classics
items.title: Plato — Apology
items.summary: I do nothing but go about persuading you all, old and young alike, not to take thought for your persons or your properties, but first and chiefly to care about the greatest improvement of the soul.

items.label: Poem
items.title: Homer — The Odyssey
items.summary:
O prince, in early youth divinely wise,
Born, the Ulysses of thy age to rise
If to the son the father’s worth descends,
O’er the wide wave success thy ways attends
To tread the walks of death he stood prepared;
And what he greatly thought, he nobly dared.
items.source: Book II · trans. Alexander Pope · Project Gutenberg

items.title: This Ancient 'Hell Chicken' Might Be the First Known Fruit-Loving Dinosaur, Revealing a Whole New Cretaceous Lifestyle
items.summary: Infernogallus jamesi had beak and mouth adaptations that hint it could mash soft foods, like today's frugivorous birds. The dinosaur probably munched on fruits resembling modern-day cherries and peaches, and may have helped spread seeds via its poop
